timing_diagnosis.estimate_error: The v2 contract projected 135-145s by linear module-count extrapolation from runtime10. It missed about 40 native-image full checks (~31s) in Torchvision's last 30% and mujoco's image-heavy load (13+ mujoco images in the characterization map).
timing_diagnosis.mechanism: After dependencies.ready, every full custody check pairs 1:1 with a newly mapped native image (85 full checks, 85 image visits). Each costs about 0.77-0.82s; a 93.7-124.8s burst ran 37 full checks for +28.6s custody. Light checks cost about 12ms each in bindings during Torchvision, up from about 4ms in torch, so their cost grows with loaded-module count. Unguarded characterization imported all four in 4.9s (mujoco 0.12s); here mujoco spent 10.3s guarded on 12 image-triggered full checks and had not returned 23.8s after entry.
